_comment: Metres. auto_calibrate=true: the receiver measures the anchor triangle from Tag ranges while the Tag moves, writes x/y here and sets auto_calibrate=false. Until then the x/y below are placeholders. Anchors and Tag are assumed at about the same height (z equal). bias_m is subtracted from each anchor's range. Add "room": {"x0":..,"y0":..,"x1":..,"y1":..} to draw a room outline.
